Problem: Read N people and M photos, each a left-to-right ordering of all N people. Print how many pairs of people never stood next to each other in any photo, as an integer.

```python
# Marks every pair that stood side by side in some photo and counts the unmarked pairs
n,m = map(int,input().split())

    a = list(map(int,input().split()))
    for i in range (n-1):
        x,y = a[i],a[i+1]
        hunaka[x-1][y-1]=0
        hunaka[y-1][x-1]=0
ans = sum(sum(row) for row in hunaka) - n
print(ans/2)
```
